executiveSummary.headline: Make the Family Golf Resort Proposition Easier for Planners to Choose
executiveSummary.lead: Sheraton Mallorca Arabella Golf Hotel’s central issue is absolute visibility: 20.6% consideration, 35.6% scenario presence, and third place among four Bonvoy peers. Official content is already rich—four courses and 63 holes, Kids Club, Shine Spa, and dining. The opportunity is to package those strengths clearly for international leisure and group planners, not to frame the result as peer embarrassment.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared; Certified Peer Position compares only the certified four-hotel set. Presence does not equal bookings, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: The Absolute Visibility Gap Is the Business Story
themes.what: The hotel appears in 35.6% of eligible scenarios and 20.6% of comparable consideration answers, despite rich official content.
themes.whyItMatters: The third-place rank is context, not embarrassment. Management should investigate where the family-friendly golf proposition is absent or unclear without claiming that content alone caused the measured gap.

themes.title: Golf, Family, Wellness, and Dining Form a Distinct Offer
themes.what: Marriott presents access to four courses and 63 holes, Kids Club, Shine Spa, and multiple dining experiences.
themes.whyItMatters: International group planners need consistent golf access conditions, family-program details, seasonal availability, meeting fit, and inquiry routing before these strengths can function as a dependable resort or retreat proposition.

themes.title: Sister-Cluster Positioning Is an Opportunity
themes.what: Sheraton’s family-friendly golf resort role differs naturally from Castillo’s adults-only Luxury Collection castle, although ADP observed sister-hotel displacement.
themes.whyItMatters: Cluster leadership can clarify complementary audiences and occasions without negative rivalry. Any incentive or golf-retreat package should remain optional and proceed only if sales and operations want that demand.

priorities.action: Hotel and Arabella Golf: lock access, family, wellness, dining, and meeting facts
Sales: test international planner journey and golf-retreat fit
priorities.desiredOutcome: Approved content brief or documented no-go

priorities.action: Cluster leadership: define Sheraton and Castillo audience roles
Marriott platform support: investigate bounded 403 behavior

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: International planners can understand approved golf access, family programming, meetings, wellness, dining, and inquiry paths; sister-hotel roles are complementary; and platform access has a documented outcome.
executiveSummary.closing: Sheraton Mallorca Arabella Golf Hotel needs stronger absolute consideration, but it does not need a new identity. Clarify the existing family-friendly golf resort offer for international planners, define its complementary role beside Castillo, and package incentive or retreat demand only when commercial leadership confirms the fit.

actions.whyItMatters: Complementary cluster positioning can help route suitable demand without negative rivalry or unsupported claims about why either hotel appeared in monitored answers.

methodology.scope: Combines the certified ADP baseline with a bounded review of named public pages and zero-cost technical probes. No paid research, Airtable write, ADP remeasurement, or customer publication was performed.
claimTypeGuide: VERIFIED_ISSUE — a directly observed, source-backed discrepancy.
RECOMMENDED_INVESTIGATION — evidence warrants review but does not prove a defect or cause.
REQUIRES_HOTEL_CONFIRMATION — hotel leadership must establish the source of truth before correction.
OPTIONAL_COMMERCIAL_OPPORTUNITY — proceed only if leadership wants the demand.
responsibilities: Hotel leadership confirms facts, priorities, and public changes.
Digital or brand teams implement only approved corrections and document verification.
Dealality packages measurement context and evidence without implying booking or revenue causation.
methodology.monthlyReviewRelationship: Approved actions may be tracked in a later review. Completing an action does not itself prove a change in AI presence, bookings, or revenue.
